title: Suite
description: Definition of a Maestro test suite: a named collection of testcases, each an ordered list of steps and/or scenario calls. Scenarios are defined separately and referenced here by their file path. Datasets are defined separately and referenced by their file path from a step's dataset field. If a step's dataset (or a scenario call's dataset) names a dataset with 'rows', that step/scenario call runs once per row.

name.description: Optional human-readable display label for the suite (e.g. "Checkout Flow"), shown in results/UI. Not used to reference it — suites are referenced by their file path (or supplied ad-hoc), so this need not be unique.

description.description: Optional free-text description of what the suite covers.

testcases.description: Ordered list of testcases that make up this suite.

name.description: Human-readable name for the testcase (e.g. "Add to cart").

description.description: Optional free-text description of what the testcase verifies.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute for this testcase. Each entry is either a template-step (client + template + dataset) or a call into a reusable scenario (scenario + optional dataset).

examples.name: Checkout Flow
examples.description: Verifies a logged-in user can add an item to the cart and pay successfully.
